description_en: Creates a scaling group to automatically adjust computing capacity by adding or removing instances of a specified type based on business demands and policies
description_zh: 如果您需要根据业务变动需求与策略自动增加或减少指定类型的实例数量，则可以通过调用API CreateScalingGroup创建伸缩组来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）
name: CreateScalingGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling group. The name must be unique within a region.

The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character.

Default value: the value of ScalingGroupId
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的名称，同一地域下伸缩组名称唯一。

长度为2~64个英文或中文字符，以数字、大小写英文字母或中文开头，可以包含数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.）。

默认值为ScalingGroupId的值
parameters.name: scaling_group_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance launch template. This parameter is used to specify the launch template from which the scaling group obtains launch configurations
parameters.help_zh: 实例启动模板ID，用于指定伸缩组从实例启动模板获取启动配置信息
parameters.name: launch_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the instance launch template. Valid values:

A specific template version number.

Default: always uses the default version of the template.

Latest: always uses the latest version of the template
parameters.help_zh:
实例启动模板的版本。取值范围：

固定的模板版本号。

Default：始终使用模板默认版本。

Latest：始终使用模板最新版本
parameters.name: launch_template_version

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. When you create a scaling group, Auto Scaling obtains the required configuration information from the specified instance and automatically creates a scaling configuration
parameters.help_zh: 实例的ID。创建伸缩组时，将从指定的实例获取所需的配置信息，并自动创建伸缩配置
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of instances in the scaling group. When the number of instances in the scaling group is less than the value of MinSize, Auto Scaling automatically creates instances. 

The value of MinSize must be less than or equal to the value of MaxSize
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组内实例台数的最小值，当伸缩组内实例数小于MinSize的值时，弹性伸缩会自动创建实例。 

MinSize的值必须小于或等于MaxSize的值
parameters.name: min_size

The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. When the number of instances in the scaling group is greater than the value of MaxSize, Auto Scaling automatically removes instances. 

<props="china">The valid values of MaxSize depend on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to check the quota for the maximum number of instances in a scaling group.</props>

<props="intl">The valid values of MaxSize depend on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas) to check the quota for the maximum number of instances in a scaling group.</props>

<props="partner">The valid values of MaxSize depend on your Auto Scaling usage. Go to Quota Center to check the quota for the maximum number of instances in a scaling group.</props>

If the quota for the maximum number of instances in a scaling group is 2000, the valid values of MaxSize are 0 to 2000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组内实例台数的最大值，当伸缩组内实例数大于MaxSize的值时，弹性伸缩会自动移出实例。 

<props="china">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心 (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas)查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

<props="intl">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心 (https://quotas.console.aliyun.com/products/ess/quotas)查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

<props="partner">MaxSize的取值范围和弹性伸缩使用情况有关，请前往配额中心查看单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值。</props>

如果单个伸缩组可以设置的组内最大实例数对应的配额值为2000，则MaxSize的取值范围为0~2000

parameters.help_en:
The cooldown time after a scaling activity (adding or removing instances) is completed. Valid values: 0 to 86400. Unit: seconds.

During the cooldown time, the scaling group does not execute other scaling activities. This parameter takes effect only for scaling activities triggered by CloudMonitor event-triggered tasks.  

Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh:
一次伸缩活动（添加或移出实例）结束后的一段冷却时间。取值范围：0~86400，单位：秒。

冷却时间内，该伸缩组不执行其他的伸缩活动，仅针对云监控报警任务触发的伸缩活动有效。  

默认值：300

RDS实例ID。取值可以是由多台RDS实例ID组成一个JSON数组，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

parameters.help_en:
The filtering policy of the scale-in policy. Valid values:

OldestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: removes the ECS instances that were added to the scaling group at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: removes the ECS instances that are created based on the earliest scaling configuration.
CustomPolicy: removes ECS instances based on a custom scale-in policy Function.

The scaling configuration mentioned in OldestScalingConfiguration refers to the instance configuration source in the scaling group, including scaling configurations and launch templates. CustomPolicy can only be set as the first removal policy. If you specify CustomPolicy, you must also specify the CustomPolicyARN parameter.

The removal of ECS instances from a scaling group is also affected by the multi-zone scaling policy (MultiAZPolicy) of the scaling group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/254822.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定实例移出策略的筛选策略。取值范围：

OldestInstance：移出最早加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新加入伸缩组的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早伸缩配置创建的ECS实例。
CustomPolicy：基于自定义缩容策略Function函数移除ECS实例。

OldestScalingConfiguration中提到的伸缩配置泛指组内实例配置信息来源，包括伸缩配置和启动模板。CustomPolicy仅支持设置为首位移除策略，当指定CustomPolicy需同时指定CustomPolicyARN参数。

伸缩组移出ECS实例还受伸缩组的扩缩容策略（MultiAZPolicy）影响。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/254822.html
parameters.name: removal_policies

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch. After this parameter is specified, the network type of the scaling group is VPC.

If neither VSwitchId nor VSwitchIds is specified for the scaling group, the network type of the scaling group is classic network by default
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机的ID。指定后，伸缩组的网络类型为专有网络。

当伸缩组未指定VSwitchId或VSwitchIds参数时，伸缩组的网络类型默认为经典网络
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The multi-zone scaling policy for ECS instances in the scaling group. Valid values: 
         
PRIORITY: the vSwitches specified by VSwitchIds are prioritized. Auto Scaling preferentially attempts to scale instances in the zone where the highest-priority vSwitch resides. If the scaling fails, Auto Scaling automatically attempts to scale instances in the zone where the next highest-priority vSwitch resides.  
COST_OPTIMIZED: during a scale-out activity, Auto Scaling attempts to create ECS instances in ascending order of vCPU unit price. During a scale-in activity, Auto Scaling attempts to remove ECS instances in descending order of vCPU unit price. If the scaling configuration sets multiple instance types that use the preemptible billing method, spot instances are preferentially created. You can use the CompensateWithOnDemand parameter to specify whether to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances when spot instances cannot be created due to insufficient inventory or other reasons. 

    > COST_OPTIMIZED takes effect only when the scaling configuration specifies multiple instance types or uses spot instances. 
BALANCE: evenly allocates ECS instances across the zones specified for the scaling group. If the distribution becomes unbalanced across zones due to insufficient inventory or other reasons, you can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71516.html operation to balance the resources.

    > If the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to BALANCE, the effect is the same as when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE and the AzBalance parameter is set to true. 
COMPOSABLE: a combined policy. You can combine the preceding multi-zone scaling policies for ECS instances based on your needs. You can also specify additional parameters to control the capacity of the scaling group in a more fine-grained manner.

Default value: PRIORITY
parameters.help_zh:
多可用区伸缩组ECS实例扩缩容策略。取值范围： 
         
PRIORITY：先指定的虚拟交换机（VSwitchIds）优先级最高。弹性伸缩优先在优先级最高的交换机所在可用区尝试扩缩容，如果无法扩缩容，则自动在下一优先级的交换机所在可用区进行扩缩容。  
COST_OPTIMIZED：扩容时弹性伸缩按vCPU单价从低到高尝试创建ECS实例，缩容时按vCPU单价从高到低尝试移出ECS实例。当伸缩配置设置了抢占式计费方式的多实例规格时，优先创建对应抢占式实例。您可以继续通过CompensateWithOnDemand参数指定当抢占式实例由于库存等原因无法创建时，是否自动尝试以按量付费的方式创建。 

    > COST_OPTIMIZED仅在伸缩配置设置了多实例规格或者选用了抢占式实例的情况下生效。 
BALANCE：在伸缩组指定的多可用区之间均匀分配ECS实例。如果由于库存不足等原因可用区之间变得不平衡，您可以通过API https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/71516.html平衡资源。

    >如果`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`BALANCE`时，其和`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略且`AzBalance`参数取值为`true`时的效果相同。 
COMPOSABLE：是一种组合策略，您可以根据需要自主组合上述多可用区伸缩组ECS实例的扩缩容策略。或者进一步指定参数，对伸缩组的容量进行更精细地控制。

默认值：PRIORITY
parameters.name: multi_az_policy

parameters.help_en:
The health check pattern of the scaling group. Valid values:

NONE: disables health checks.
ECS: performs health checks on instances in the scaling group. This value is used to enable instance health checks for both ECS and ECI scaling groups.
LOAD_BALANCER: determines the health status of instances based on the health check results of the load balancer. CLB is not supported.


Default value: ECS.

If you need to enable both instance health checks and load balancing health checks, use the HealthCheckTypes parameter
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。取值范围：

NONE：不做健康检查。
ECS：对伸缩组内的实例做健康检查（ECS类型和ECI类型的伸缩组均使用本取值开启实例健康检查）。
LOAD_BALANCER: 根据负载均衡（暂不支持CLB负载均衡类型）健康检查结果判断实例健康状态。


默认值：ECS。

如果需要同时开启实例健康检查和负载均衡健康检查，请使用`HealthCheckTypes`参数
parameters.name: health_check_type

parameters.help_en:
The reclaim mode of the scaling group. Valid values: 
         
recycle: sets the reclaim mode of the scaling group to the shutdown and reclaim mode.  
release: sets the reclaim mode of the scaling group to the release mode.
forcerelease: sets the reclaim mode of the scaling group to the forcible release mode.
    > If you select forcerelease, the system forcibly releases instances in the Running state during a scale-down activity. Forcibly releasing an instance is equivalent to a power-off operation, which clears temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.
forcerecycle: sets the reclaim mode of the scaling group to the forcible shutdown and reclaim mode.
    > If you select forcerecycle, the system forcibly shuts down instances in the Running state during a scale-down activity. Forcibly shutting down an instance is equivalent to a power-off operation, which clears temporary data in the memory and storage of the instance. The data cannot be recovered. Proceed with caution.


The ScalingPolicy parameter specifies the reclaim mode of the scaling group, but the specific action taken when an instance is removed from the scaling group is determined by the RemovePolicy parameter of RemoveInstances. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定伸缩组的回收模式。取值范围： 
         
recycle：伸缩组的回收模式为停机回收模式。  
release：伸缩组的回收模式为释放模式。
forcerelease：伸缩组的回收模式为强制释放模式。
    >选择forcerelease后，在弹性收缩活动中系统会强制释放`运行中`（Running）的实例。强制释放实例相当于断电操作，会导致该实例内存以及存储中的临时数据被擦除，数据无法恢复，请您谨慎选择。
forcerecycle：伸缩组的回收模式为强制停机回收模式。
    >选择forcerecycle后，在弹性收缩活动中系统会强制关机`运行中`（Running）的实例。强制关机相当于断电操作，会导致该实例内存以及存储中的临时数据被擦除，数据无法恢复，请您谨慎选择。


ScalingPolicy指定伸缩组的回收模式，但实例被移出伸缩组时的具体动作，由RemoveInstances的RemovePolicy参数决定。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html
parameters.name: scaling_policy

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances is less than this value, pay-as-you-go instances are preferentially created
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组所需要按量实例个数的最小值，取值范围：0~1000。当按量实例个数少于该值时，将优先创建按量实例。
parameters.name: on_demand_base_capacity

parameters.help_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the instances that exceed the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances (OnDemandBaseCapacity) in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组满足最小按量实例数（OnDemandBaseCapacity）要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100
parameters.name: on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the Auto Scaling policy to supplement spot instances. After this feature is enabled, when the scaling group receives a system message indicating that a spot instance will be reclaimed, the scaling group attempts to create a new instance to replace the spot instance to be reclaimed
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启补齐抢占式实例的弹性伸缩策略。开启后，当收到抢占式实例将被回收的系统消息时，伸缩组将尝试创建新的实例，替换掉将被回收的抢占式实例
parameters.name: spot_instance_remedy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COST_OPTIMIZED and sufficient spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory constraints. Valid values:

true: allows the creation.
false: does not allow the creation.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
当MultiAZPolicy取值为COST_OPTIMIZED时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许。

默认值：true
parameters.name: compensate_with_on_demand

parameters.help_en: The number of available instance types. The scaling group evenly creates spot instances across multiple instance types with the lowest cost. Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定可用实例规格的个数，伸缩组将按成本最低的多个规格均衡创建抢占式实例。取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: spot_instance_pools

parameters.help_en: The expected number of instances in the scaling group. The scaling group automatically maintains the number of instances at the expected number. The value cannot be greater than MaxSize or less than MinSize
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组内实例的期望数量，伸缩组会自动将实例数量维持在期望实例数。取值不得大于MaxSize，且不得小于MinSize
parameters.name: desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the scaling group. Valid values:

true: enables deletion protection for the scaling group. In this case, the scaling group cannot be deleted.
false: disables deletion protection for the scaling group.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启伸缩组删除保护。取值范围：

true：开启伸缩组删除保护，此时不能删除该伸缩组。
false：关闭伸缩组删除保护。

默认值：false
parameters.name: group_deletion_protection

parameters.help_en:
The type of instances managed by the scaling group. Valid values:

ECS: the scaling group manages ECS instances.

ECI: the scaling group manages ECI instances.

Default value: ECS
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组管理的实例类型。取值范围：

ECS：伸缩组内管理的伸缩为ECS实例。

ECI：伸缩组内管理的伸缩为ECI实例。

默认值：ECS
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: The ECI instance ID, which is the container group ID
parameters.help_zh: ECI实例ID，即容器组ID
parameters.name: container_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of one or more vSwitches. If you specify the VSwitchIds parameter, the VSwitchId parameter is ignored. After this parameter is specified, the network type of the scaling group is VPC.

When you specify multiple vSwitches:

The vSwitches must belong to the same VPC.

The vSwitches can reside in different zones.

The vSwitches are prioritized in ascending order of numbers. 1 indicates the highest priority. If instances cannot be created in the zone where the higher-priority vSwitch resides, the system automatically selects the next highest-priority vSwitch to create instances.

If neither VSwitchId nor VSwitchIds is specified for the scaling group, the network type of the scaling group is classic network by default
parameters.help_zh:
一台或多台虚拟交换机的ID。如果您使用了VSwitchIds参数，VSwitchId参数将被忽略。指定后，伸缩组的网络类型为专有网络。

指定多台虚拟交换机时：

所属的VPC必须相同。

所属的可用区可以不同。

虚拟交换机的优先级按照数字升序排序，1表示最高优先级。当优先级较高的虚拟交换机所在可用区无法创建实例时，自动选择下一优先级的虚拟交换机创建实例。

当伸缩组未指定VSwitchId或VSwitchIds参数时，伸缩组的网络类型默认为经典网络
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The next action to perform after the wait state ends. Valid values:

CONTINUE: continues the response to the scale-out activity or scale-down activity.

ABANDON: directly releases the instances created by the scale-out activity or directly removes the instances from the scaling group during the scale-down activity.

When a scale-down activity (SCALE_IN) occurs in the scaling group and triggers multiple lifecycle hooks, if the wait state triggered by a lifecycle hook whose DefaultResult is set to ABANDON ends, the other corresponding wait states end in advance. In other cases, the next action is subject to the next action of the last wait state that ends.

Default value: CONTINUE
fields.help_zh:
等待状态结束后的下一步动作。取值范围：

CONTINUE：继续响应弹性扩张活动或者继续响应弹性收缩活动。

ABANDON：直接释放弹性扩张活动创建出来的实例或者直接将弹性收缩活动中的实例从伸缩组移除。

当伸缩组发生弹性收缩活动（SCALE_IN）并触发多个生命周期挂钩时，DefaultResult取值为ABANDON的生命周期挂钩触发的等待状态结束时，会提前结束其它对应的等待状态。其他情况下，下一步动作均以最后一个结束等待状态的下一步动作为准。

默认值：CONTINUE
fields.name: default_result

fields.help_en:
The wait time configured by the lifecycle hook for the scaling group activity. After the wait state times out, the next action is performed. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After you create a lifecycle hook, you can call RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat to extend the wait time of the instance, or call CompleteLifecycleAction to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance.

Default value: 600
fields.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩为伸缩组活动设置的等待时间，等待状态超时后会执行下一步动作。取值范围：30~21600，单位：秒。

创建了生命周期挂钩后，您可以调用RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat延长实例的等待时间，也可以调用CompleteLifecycleAction提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态。

默认值：600

fields.help_en:

SCALE_OUT: scale-out activities of the scaling group.

SCALE_IN: scale-down activities of the scaling group.

If you specify a lifecycle hook for the scaling group, this parameter is required, and other related parameters are optional
fields.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩适用的伸缩活动类型，取值范围：

SCALE_OUT：伸缩组弹性扩张活动。

SCALE_IN：伸缩组弹性收缩活动。

若伸缩组指定生命周期挂钩，此参数必选，其他相关参数可选

The identifier of the notification recipient for the lifecycle hook. Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) queues or topics are supported. The parameter value format is acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:{resource-relative-id}.

region: the region where the scaling group resides.

account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.

Examples:

MNS queue: acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}.

MNS topic: acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}
fields.help_zh:
生命周期挂钩通知对象标识符，支持轻量消息队列（原 MNS）的队列或主题，参数取值格式：acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:{resource-relative-id}。

region：伸缩组所在的地域。

account-id：阿里云账号ID。

例如：

MNS队列：acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}。

MNS主题：acs:ess:{region}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}
fields.name: notification_arn

fields.help_en: The fixed string information for the wait state of the scaling activity. The value can be up to 4,096 characters in length. Each time Auto Scaling pushes a message to the notification recipient, it also sends the predefined value of the NotificationMetadata parameter to help you manage and tag different types of notifications. The NotificationMetadata parameter takes effect only when you also specify the NotificationArn parameter

fields.help_en:
When you need the scaling group to scale based on the instance type capacity, specify both this parameter and LaunchTemplateOverrides.WeightedCapacity.

This parameter is used to specify the instance type, which overrides the instance type in the launch template.

This parameter takes effect only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter specifies a launch template.

Valid values of InstanceType: available ECS instance types
fields.help_zh:
当您需要伸缩组按照实例规格容量进行伸缩时，请同时指定本参数和LaunchTemplateOverrides.WeightedCapacity。

本参数用于指定实例规格，会覆盖启动模板中的实例规格。

仅当LaunchTemplateId参数指定了启动模板时，本参数生效。

InstanceType的取值范围：在售的ECS实例规格
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en:
This parameter is used to specify the maximum bid price for the override instance type (LaunchTemplateOverride.InstanceType) of the instance launch template.
This parameter takes effect only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter specifies a launch template
fields.help_zh:
本参数用于指定实例启动模板覆盖规格（即`LaunchTemplateOverride.InstanceType`）的竞价价格上限。
仅当`LaunchTemplateId`参数指定了启动模板时，该参数才生效
fields.name: spot_price_limit

fields.help_en:
When you need the scaling group to scale based on the instance type capacity, specify this parameter after you specify LaunchTemplateOverrides.InstanceType.

This parameter is used to specify the weight of the instance type, which indicates the capacity that a single instance of the instance type represents in the scaling group. A larger weight indicates that fewer instances of this instance type are required to meet the expected capacity.

Because performance metrics such as the number of vCPUs and memory size vary among instance types, you can configure different weights for different instance types based on your needs.

Example:

Current capacity: 0.

Expected capacity: 6.

Capacity of the ecs.c5.xlarge instance type: 4.

To meet the expected capacity, the scaling group scales out two ecs.c5.xlarge instances for you.

During a scale-out activity, the capacity of the scaling group cannot exceed the sum of the maximum capacity (MaxSize) and the maximum weight of the instance type.

Valid values of WeightedCapacity: 1 to 500
fields.help_zh:
当您需要伸缩组按照实例规格容量进行伸缩时，在指定LaunchTemplateOverrides.InstanceType后，再指定本参数。

本参数用于指定实例规格的权重，即实例规格的单台实例在伸缩组中表示的容量大小。权重越大，满足期望容量所需的本实例规格的实例数量越少。

由于每个实例规格的vCPU个数、内存大小等性能指标会有差异，您可以根据自身需求，给不同的实例规格配置不同的权重。

例如：

当前容量：0。

期望容量：6。

ecs.c5.xlarge规格容量：4。

为满足期望容量，伸缩组将为用户扩容2台ecs.c5.xlarge实例。

扩容时伸缩组的容量不得超过最大容量（MaxSize）与实例规格的最大权重之和。

WeightedCapacity的取值范围：1~500
fields.name: weighted_capacity

Specifies whether the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

true: The capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones.

false: The capacity of the scaling group is not evenly distributed across multiple zones.

If the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE` and the `AzBalance` parameter is set to `true`, the effect is the same as when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `BALANCE`.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的容量是否在多个可用区间均衡分布（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效），取值范围：

true：伸缩组的容量在多个可用区间均衡分布。

false：伸缩组的容量不在多个可用区间均衡分布。

如果`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略，并且`AzBalance`参数取值为`true`时，其效果和`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`BALANCE`相同。

默认值：false
parameters.name: az_balance

parameters.help_en:
The capacity allocation policy, which determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet the capacity requirements. The capacity distribution policy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacity. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

priority: creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.

lowestPrice: creates instances based on the unit price per vCPU of the instance types in ascending order.

Default value: priority
parameters.help_zh:
容量分配策略，决定了伸缩组如何选择可用的实例规格类型满足容量。容量分布策略同时对按量和抢占式容量生效（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。取值范围：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。

lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例。

默认值：priority
parameters.name: allocation_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The spot capacity distribution policy. You can use this parameter to specify the distribution policy for spot capacity separately. This parameter takes effect only when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`. Valid values:

priority: creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.

lowestPrice: creates instances based on the unit price per vCPU of the instance types in ascending order.

Default value: priority
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式容量分布策略。您可以通过该参数单独指定抢占式容量的分布策略（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。取值范围：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。

lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例。

默认值：priority

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for waiting for an ECS instance to be stopped during the scale-in process. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 30 to 240.

This parameter takes effect only in the scale-in process when ScalingPolicy is set to release.  
If this parameter is specified, the system waits for a maximum of the StopInstanceTimeout period for the instance to be stopped. After the timeout period elapses, the scale-in process continues regardless of whether the instance is stopped.  
If this parameter is not specified, the system waits for a long time for the instance to be stopped. The scale-in process continues only after the instance is stopped. If the instance fails to be stopped, the scale-in process is rolled back and the scale-in fails
parameters.help_zh:
缩容流程中等待ECS实例停机成功的超时时间，单位为秒。
取值范围：30~240。

该参数仅在 ScalingPolicy = release 模式下的缩容流程里生效。  
如果设置了该参数，系统会最长等待StopInstanceTimeout时间将实例停机成功，超时后无论实例是否成功停机都会继续缩容。  
如果没有设置该参数，系统会长时间等待实例停机成功，只有实例停机成功后才继续缩容，停机失败时，缩容流程会回滚，缩容失败
parameters.name: stop_instance_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the system to automatically attempt to create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COST_OPTIMIZED` and sufficient spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory reasons. Valid values:

true: allowed.
false: not allowed.

Default value: true
fields.help_zh:
当`MultiAZPolicy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许。

默认值：true
fields.name: compensate_with_on_demand

fields.help_en:
The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group is less than this value, the system preferentially creates pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values: 0 to 1000.

When the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`, the default value is 0
fields.help_zh:
已有伸缩组内所需要的按量实例数的最小值，当伸缩组内按量实例个数少于该值时，系统将优先创建按量实例。取值范围：0~1000。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为0
fields.name: on_demand_base_capacity

fields.help_en:
The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances in the excess instances after the scaling group meets the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances specified by `OnDemandBaseCapacity`. Valid values: 0 to 100.

When the `MultiAZPolicy` parameter is set to `COMPOSABLE`, the default value is 100

伸缩组满足最小按量实例数`OnDemandBaseCapacity`要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例。取值范围：0～100。

当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时，默认值为100
fields.name: on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity

fields.help_en:
The price comparison mode for the cost optimization policy of the scaling group. Valid values:
PricePerUnit: compares prices based on the price per unit of capacity.

  The capacity of an instance in the scaling group is equal to the weight set for the instance type. The default weight is 1, which means one ECS instance occupies one unit of capacity.

PricePerVCpu: compares prices based on the price per vCPU.

Default value: PricePerUnit
fields.help_zh:
伸缩组成本优化策略的比价模式。取值范围：
PricePerUnit：使用每单位容量价格比价。

  实例在伸缩组中容量大小等于为实例规格设置的权重，默认为1，即一台ECS所占容量为1。

PricePerVCpu：使用每单位vCpu价格进行比价。

默认值：PricePerUnit
fields.name: price_comparison_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to attempt to use spot instances to replace pay-as-you-go capacity when `CompensateWithOnDemand` is enabled and the proportion of pay-as-you-go instances exceeds the `OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity` value. In common scenarios where `CompensateWithOnDemand` downgrades spot instances to pay-as-you-go instances due to spot inventory or price reasons, this parameter attempts to use spot instances to replace the excess pay-as-you-go capacity to avoid long-term existence of pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

true: allowed.
false: not allowed.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
当开启`CompensateWithOnDemand`后，如果按量比例超过`OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity`比例时，会尝试使用spot替换按量容量。常见场景`CompensateWithOnDemand`因Spot库存或价格原因导致Spot降级按量实例，为避免按量实例长时间存在，尝试使用Spot替换多余的按量容量。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许。

默认值：false
fields.name: spot_auto_replace_on_demand

parameters.help_en: The capacity options
parameters.help_zh: 容量选项
parameters.name: capacity_options

parameters.help_en:
The zone balancing mode. This parameter takes effect only when the zone balancing mode is enabled. Valid values:
 
BalancedBestEffort: If resource creation fails in a zone, the system degrades to other zones to ensure best-effort delivery of resources.

BalancedOnly: If resource creation fails in a zone, the system does not degrade to other zones. The scale-out activity partially succeeds to avoid excessive imbalance of resources across different zones.

Default value: BalancedBestEffort
parameters.help_zh:
可用区均衡模式，仅当开启可用区均衡模式时生效。取值范围：
 
BalancedBestEffort：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，会降级至其他可用区，保障资源的尽力交付。

BalancedOnly：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，不会降级至其他可用区，扩容活动部分成功，避免资源在不同可用区过度不均衡。

默认值：BalancedBestEffort
parameters.name: balance_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic balancing for the scaling group. This parameter takes effect only when BalancedOnly is enabled for the zone balancing scaling group. Valid values:
false: disables automatic balancing for the scaling group.
true: enables automatic balancing for the scaling group. The scaling group automatically detects the capacity across zones. If the capacity is unbalanced across zones, the scaling group proactively scales out or scales in to rebalance the capacity across zones.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启伸缩组自动均衡，仅当可用区均衡伸缩组开启了BalancedOnly才生效。取值范围：
false：不开启伸缩组自动均衡。
true：开启伸缩组自动均衡时，伸缩组会自动检测可用区见容量，当可用区容量不均衡时，会主动进行可用区扩缩，进行可用区容量再均衡。

默认值: false
parameters.name: auto_rebalance
